messages:
Kevin M.: FYI — Jess from SpendSage reached out about a 4-week POC for automated invoice reconciliation. They say they can ingest raw S3 CSVs and map our weird sku_field. @Anna (procurement) any constraints on vendor access? 

Jess (SpendSage): Hi all — thanks Kevin. We can run a trial for 4 weeks, ingest up to 250k invoices, and provide mapping and confidence scores. Trial includes 2 engineer hours for on-boarding. Pricing outline below and here's the POC doc: https://spendsage.app/pocteam

Anna (procurement): Thanks. High level pricing? committed vs pay-as-you-go? any minimums or setup fees? Also need SOC2 / SSO info.

Jess (SpendSage): Basic pricing: $0.12 per processed invoice on pay-as-you-go; volume tiers at 250k+ drop to $0.09. Or committed plan: $15k/mo for up to 200k invoices, incl. mapping & 24/5 support. One-time onboarding fee $3k if no commit. SOC2 Type II, SAML SSO, IL4 availability on request. 

Samir G.: Do they charge per line-item or per invoice? Our average invoice has 7 lines — that delta matters.

Jess (SpendSage): Per processed invoice regardless of lines. For large receipts/POs we can negotiate line-item pricing. Also offer optional 'auto-match' add-on for $0.02/invoice that boosts match-rate.

Tara P.: Can they output our canonical fields? We need vendor_id, internal_sku, net_amount, invoice_date, invoice_id, cost_center. Any sample payload? 

Jess (SpendSage): Yep. Sample JSON payload:
```
{
  "invoice_id": "INV-2025-1245",
  "vendor_id": "VND-88",
  "invoice_date": "2025-02-03",
  "net_amount": 12543.20,
  "lines": [ {"sku":"RWD-ALPHA-01","qty":2,"line_total":6250.00} ],
  "internal_sku": "al-01"
}
```
We also accept CSV and S3 paths. 

Kevin M.: For POC we should ask for a no-cost trial or credits — we won't hand over real invoices until NDA is signed. Anna, what vendor docs do you need to start legal? 

Anna (procurement): NDA + DPA are musts. Also need SOC2 report and a data-flow diagram. I'll ask for pricing in writing and whether credits can be applied to commit later. 

Jess (SpendSage): We can do a 30k-invoice credit for an intro POC (no charge). NDA + DPA fine. I'll email the SOC2 link and architecture diagram. Also happy to do a 30-min tech call this week. 

InvoiceBot: New POC request created: POCPROJ-310 (owner: Kevin M.). 

Samir G.: Quick cost check — if commit route: $15k/mo for 200k invoices = $0.075/invoice. With our current volume (~450k/mo) commit would be ~$33.75k/mo vs payg ~ $54k/mo. So commit seems worth it but need try-and-verify match rates. 

Tara P.: Agree. Let's do the free 30k trial, legal starts NDA, schedule tech call. Kevin, can you coord with engineering for sample payload? 

Kevin M.: On it. I'll upload sanitized sample CSV to the secure bucket and tag Jess. :thumbsup:
